test_title: PYST 61: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part of the following sentence.

Mathew decided to complete the marathon to prove that he is still __fit as a fiddle__ in his eighties.

options.text: an owner of a fit horse

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"fit as a fiddle"** means someone who is in excellent physical condition; very fit and energetic. (बेहद फिट और ऊर्जावान)

 
 
• **Example: **Even at 70, my grandfather is** fit as a fiddle** and goes for a jog every morning.
 
 
 
• **"Fit and energetic person"** refers to someone who is physically healthy and full of energy. (फिट और ऊर्जावान व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his busy schedule, John is a **fit and energetic person** who never misses his gym sessions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: An owner of a fit horse** (फिट घोड़े का मालिक): This phrase is not commonly used to describe a person's physical condition.

 
 
• **Example:** He is an** owner of a fit horse**, which wins many races.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A man of great qualities** (महान गुणों वाला व्यक्ति): This phrase refers to someone with admirable traits but does not specifically indicate physical fitness.
 
 
• **Example:** Mahatma Gandhi was **a man of great qualities.**
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Proud and unreliable** (घमंडी और अविश्वसनीय): This phrase has a negative connotation and does not relate to physical fitness.
 
 
• **Example:** He is **proud and unreliable**, making it hard to trust him.
 
 

 

42:Te30,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
